my gen alpha team members:

Goh Yi Kai,Shu Ung,Gabrian,Lee Tze Kang,Wei Hao
summary: Our project name is called The Goldilocks Protocol.The meaning of goldilocks means just right.In our game,that word specifies on building rockets again and again until we get it just right.The story of our game is about a labaratory exploding,releasing green gas everywhere,turning people into zombies.In the game we send robots to fight zombies.Then,the robots bring will bring back coins for protagonists to buys rockets and satellites.You are on a mission to build and send rockets with statellites out of space to go on diffrent planets and the moon to find information so the survivors can find a suitable place to regrow and rebuild.In the game,if you build the rocket using the wrong equipment or filling the rocket using the wrong amount of fuel,your rocket will explode.We added this effect because we don't want people to succeed even when they're wrong.We want people to learn from their mistakes,we want people to keep trying until they get it right.We build this game not only for people to explore space and go on mission,but also for people to know that failure is the key to succees.This game is important because it gives us more exposer to space and it also teaches us moral values.
details: In the game, we can build rockets and go on missions.It not only lets us learn more about space,but also teaches us that failure is the mother of succees.This is because in the game,you have to build a rocket with the correct parts,the correct amount of fuel and the correct probe to succeed.This game can improve decision-making as it encourages players to think wisely.Not only that,the game promotes resource management as it teaches players to use limited supplies and coins wisely.We used canva,chat gpt,dreamina,gemini,capcut,Godot, Kling Ai and prisma 3D to make our video and game,for our coding language,we used GDscripts,we also used software to develop our project.Our project is creative because we used a fictional story that's interesting as most people like stories about zombies.The factors we considered were our gameplay,the game's difficulty,resources and creativity.
